notes: Values are the picBunch fast-near evaluator (picBunch::pbfast::shape_field) with the final default observer-cell exact routing at unit cells, compared against the independent exact-field reference. The default lowers the stationary interior worst case to 3.71e-4 (from 6.82e-4); moving axial and oblique interior stay at 1.40e-4 and 1.94e-3, and the face/outside rows are unchanged. CPU-only: no alpaka, CUDA, or FFTW is linked.
